services.description: List of services to offer via inetd. Each entry defines a service name, protocol, and how to launch the corresponding server program.

name.description: Service name (e.g., 'ftp', 'telnet', 'echo'). Must match an entry in /etc/services.

flags.description: Flags: 'wait', 'nowait', 'nowait.max', or 'internal'. For TCP: 'wait' (single-threaded), 'nowait' (multi-threaded). For UDP: usually 'wait'. 'internal' means built-in (e.g., 'finger', 'auth').

server_type.description: Server type: 'rpc/tcp', 'rpc/udp', or empty string for non-RPC services (e.g., '' or 'rpc/tcp').

server_program.description: Path to the server program (e.g., '/usr/sbin/in.ftpd'). For internal services, use the internal name (e.g., 'internal').

server_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to the server program.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the service (used for inline comment).
